register.name: MJ-ART archive register
register.registerDateNote: Consolidation/register date. The exact original capture date of each collection prior to 2026-07-29 was not recorded in the existing archive documentation; 2026-07-29 is the date this register and the current archive reorganization were created.

preArchiveBaseline.note: Working-tree state immediately before archiving. Identifies the pre-archive commit.

register.productionAccessedNote: No production, Cloudflare, R2, database, secrets, network, deploy, or external access was performed during archiving or the creation of this register.

taxonomy.reviewDatesNote: Review dates are review/reminders only — they are NOT expiry or deletion dates. No item is ever deleted automatically or by reaching a date. Deletion always requires explicit human confirmation.

deletionEvidenceSchema.description: Optional structure for future duplicate/deletion-candidate records. A record may only receive a DELETE recommendation from archive/review.mjs when deletionEvidence.hasDuplicateRecoverableEvidence is true, the content is checksum-valid, unreferenced, and due. No current record carries deletion approval (every current record has deletionEvidence: null). The review tool never performs or exposes deletion.

fields.hasDuplicateRecoverableEvidence: boolean — true ONLY when byte-identical content is independently verified to exist in a recoverable non-archive location and removal would not cause data loss.
fields.verifiedAgainst: string — path or identifier of the verified duplicate source.
fields.verifiedMethod: string — how the duplicate was verified (e.g., 'SHA-256 + byte-size match at same relative path').
fields.verifiedDate: string (strict YYYY-MM-DD) — date the duplicate evidence was independently verified.
fields.evidence: string — human-readable summary of the duplicate/recoverable evidence.

deletionEvidenceSchema.note: When deletionEvidence is null or absent, the record can never receive a DELETE recommendation regardless of classification or due status.

checksumAlgorithm.description: Deterministic aggregate tree checksum. For every regular file under the collection directory, sorted by POSIX relative path, emit the UTF-8 line `relpath|sha256(fileBytes)|size\n`; the checksum is the SHA-256 hex of that concatenated byte stream. It is independent of on-disk absolute pathing and sensitive to both content and the set of relative paths.

records.provenance: Former top-level GitHub Pages site. Moved verbatim from the repository's former docs/ tree. Byte-identical to the pre-archive git HEAD docs/ tree (26/26 files matched by path, size, and SHA-256).
records.reason: Superseded by the active Cloudflare Worker app (apps/web). The legacy static site is no longer wired into any build or deploy step; retained as a historical fallback.
records.dependenciesAndReferences: Not imported, built, deployed, or referenced by any active app code, config, or workflow. Independently verified content overlap against apps/web/public: 21 of 26 files are byte-identical (same relative path, SHA-256, and byte size) — all 17 artwork images, artworks.json, admin.css, styles.css, and artwork/inventory-template.txt. The 5 differing files (index.html, admin.html, admin.js, script.js, artwork/README.txt) have divergent content vs their apps/web counterparts. These duplicate bytes are retained because they are internal dependencies of the self-contained legacy snapshot; this does NOT make the record a deletion candidate (deletionEvidence is null).
records.proposedReviewDateRationale: Annual integrity review for retired/permanent-history material.
records.finalDeletionStatus: not a deletion candidate — preserved indefinitely
